# id: PG-pg-83-balance-engineering
# covers: PG 185 (Section L balance sweep, generated by tools/balance_driver.py gen; edit the generator, not this file)
# fixture: Testing-Save-Full-Base (squad Beaks + Avarek)
# reset: fresh
# needs: ProfessionGearProgression.dll 36D7474D+ (pg_statprobe), harness c5a5c88+ (give artifacts, research start any; 90a0e33: teleport moved=/bed, speed hold; 6933d0f: fill topup, drop all; 616121b: benches near; c4fa520: pin, d91fe88: face) (KAH 24: chance, detect, detecttime, healtime, findwater, swimtime, construct, construction); client kah.py from the harness repo (LONG_COMMANDS has the KAH 24 timers); set_test_mode.ps1 -Mode Forced -Rules InGameTest
# design: per window a fresh Small Shack construction site (harness construct: unfinished, materials in, BUILD job)
#   next to Avarek, built for 5 game minutes at speed 10; result = construction progress (0..1).
#   The site is removed after each window (unbuild).
# verify: progress > 0 and < 1 in every window (1 = saturated: tell the PG agent to shorten the window or
#   pick a bigger building; the construct reply shows build_hours). own50 > none = building reads the
#   hooked Engineering.
#   Data: python3 tools/balance_driver.py csv <out> > balance.csv; python3 tools/analyze_balance.py balance.csv
@wait-world
@sleep 8
speed 0
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 4
speed 0
protect Beaks on
protect Avarek on
hunger Avarek 280
hunger Beaks 280
select Avarek
clearjobs Avarek
pg_statprobe on Avarek
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 30 ~ moved=1
give Avarek "Iron Hat" 1
equip Avarek "Iron Hat"
pg_info Avarek "Iron Hat" ~ equipped=1
# --- w1: skill 10, gear none ---
setstat Avarek engineering 10
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
@set P0 construct Avarek "Small Shack" dist 12 ~ progress=([-\d.]+)
stat Avarek engineering
@set T0 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
speed 10 hold
@wait-game 5 900
speed 0
@set T1 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
stat Avarek engineering
@set P1 construction "Small Shack" ~ progress=([-\d.]+) complete=0
@echo BAL2,185,engineering,10,0,none,w1,construct,T${T0}_${T1},${P0},${P1}
pg_statprobe read
clearjobs Avarek
unbuild "Small Shack"
hunger Avarek 280
# --- w2: skill 90, gear none ---
setstat Avarek engineering 90
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
@set P0 construct Avarek "Small Shack" dist 12 ~ progress=([-\d.]+)
stat Avarek engineering
@set T0 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
speed 10 hold
@wait-game 5 900
speed 0
@set T1 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
stat Avarek engineering
@set P1 construction "Small Shack" ~ progress=([-\d.]+) complete=0
@echo BAL2,185,engineering,90,0,none,w2,construct,T${T0}_${T1},${P0},${P1}
pg_statprobe read
clearjobs Avarek
unbuild "Small Shack"
hunger Avarek 280

# --- w4: skill 50, gear own25 ---
